title: Playing my multiplayer AI game with two friends
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
I recorded a play session last night with 2 of my friends where we're trying to farm for some dinosaur skins to craft weapons and build a base in my latest game 100% made with AI, the game is SUPER hard but we had blast

Built this game using the new agent loop tool where you let multiple AI agents run uninterrupted to build and self-critique their own game build. I set the loop budget to $50 and let the agents rip based on my prompt, references and instructions.

Took about 2 days from start to finish, and now it's fully playable - with open world multiplayer!



Happy to share workflow and prompts in the comments
